correctness.rationale: For each of the six *finite* graphs, all 2^(3n)-1 square subsets are tested by exact induced adjacency. A reproducible complete alternating Hasse-poset matching is proved acyclic by a topological ordering of every covering relation. The integer signed gradient recursion independently calculates zero Morse differential, leaving critical cells (0:1,1:1), (0:1,1:4), (0:1,2:5), (0:1,3:13), (0:1,3:61), (0:1,3:113,4:7). For the final case the Hurewicz isomorphism pi3(vee^113 S3)=Z^113 shows zero attaching coefficients force seven null four-cell attachments. Distinct mod-two boundary-rank computation corroborates the Betti numbers; no extrapolation for n>=7.

value.rationale: Three-row rook graphs are a canonical narrow-width Cartesian graph family and their 2-independence complexes are a natural next object after the well-studied ordinary chessboard complexes. The sharp first mixed-dimensional homotopy transition at six columns is non-obvious: 113 three-spheres coexist with exactly seven four-spheres. The result gives six complete integral homotopy types and a fully reproducible finite benchmark for possible general recurrences, rather than an arbitrary isolated numerical homology rank.
